Water-cycle presentation

Of course! The water cycle is water’s journey around Earth. Here’s a simple explanation for your presentation: Evaporation: The sun warms water in rivers, lakes and oceans, turning it into invisible water vapour. Condensation: As the vapour cools, it forms tiny droplets that gather into clouds. Precipitation: Water falls from clouds as rain or snow. Collection: Water gathers in rivers, lakes and oceans, while some soaks into the ground. Then the journey begins again! You can remember it as: up, clouds, down, and around! Source: USGS Water Science School
